project: Oy karvonsaroyi - Team OUTPOST, NASA Space Apps 2026
units: metres; glTF Y-up; front = +Z where it makes sense
collision_convention: Each GLB has the visual mesh node '<id>' and a collider node 'COL_<id>' (no material; hide it). Box colliders: node extras/userData.boxes = JSON string of [cx, cy, cz, sx, sy, sz] in metres (glTF axes, asset space). Terrain colliders are low-poly meshes (userData.collider = 'mesh').

gravity.note: NSSDC fact sheets (read 2026-11-14): Earth mean surface gravity 9.820 (equator 9.780) - 9.81 is standard g rounded; Moon 1.62; Mars mean 3.73 (equator 3.69) - 3.71 is used as the game value.

credit: 3D models: NASA 3D Resources / NASA Science (NASA/JPL-Caltech). Not endorsed by NASA.
brand_rule: No NASA logos, seals, US flags, mission patches or agency wordmarks in any exported texture (checked by eye).
moon_level: Not made yet - the Moon level will be built later from the team spec (game3d/levels/).
